This land no be my own, I dey rent am, so I no fit spend plenty money on top am like say na my own. For my cassava and yam this season, I go buy small NPK from the market to help the soil because the rented plot don tire small, but I no fit afford too much. I still get my goat and chicken droppings wey I dey gather for house, so I go carry am come spread for the mounds. For seed, I go use the cassava cuttings and yam setts wey I save from last year — na them sabi this our South South soil well well. The rain dey fall plenty for here so I no need irrigation, and I go do most of the work myself with my children, only call small hired hand when time to make the heaps reach.
